instruction: Apply strikethrough formatting to the text 'References Cited' on slide 10 of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed slide number color to red by navigating to Master View, selecting the slide number placeholder, opening Format > Character > Font Effects, and setting the font color to RGB(255,0,0) via the custom color picker.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, access Master View, select slide number placeholders, change font colors using Format > Character dialog with custom RGB color picker
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a different text formatting operation (strikethrough) on the same presentation, leveraging the model's demonstrated ability to navigate Format > Character dialog
metadata.explanation: Task requires applying strikethrough to 'References Cited' text on slide 10. Custom getter scans all shapes/paragraphs on slide 10 (index 9) for text content and strikethrough status. Custom metric checks if any paragraph containing 'References Cited' has strikethrough formatting. [Fixed: replaced official check_strikethrough (which expects index-based keys slide_index_s, shape_index_s, paragraph_index_s) with custom text-search-based getter+metric that finds the target text by content rather than by positional indices.]
